pillars.name: Data Analysis
pillars.intro: Learn how to turn raw data into clear insights, useful questions, and better decisions.

lessons.title: Rôle du Data Analyst et cycle d’analyse
lessons.short: What a Data Analyst actually does
lessons.practice: Map a business question to the data, analysis, and decision it would require.

lessons.title: Excel : tableaux, références et formules utiles
lessons.practice: Build a clean analysis table and use formulas to answer a simple question.

lessons.title: Python : variables, types, conditions et boucles
lessons.practice: Write a short script that transforms and checks a small dataset.

lessons.title: pandas : DataFrame, Series et index
lessons.practice: Load a dataset and inspect its columns, types, index, and basic statistics.

lessons.title: Importer CSV/Excel et profiler un jeu de données
lessons.practice: Import a file and create a short data-quality profile.

lessons.title: Nettoyer les valeurs manquantes
lessons.practice: Compare several ways to treat missing values and justify one choice.

lessons.title: Détecter doublons, incohérences et outliers
lessons.practice: Identify duplicates, inconsistent values, and potential outliers.

pillars.name: Data Science
pillars.intro: Learn how data, probability, models, and evaluation work together to solve predictive problems.

lessons.title: Workflow Data Science : problème, données, modèle, décision
lessons.practice: Take one prediction problem and define its data, target, evaluation, and decision.

lessons.title: Features, target et types de variables
lessons.practice: Separate features and target on a small supervised-learning example.

lessons.title: Probabilités : événements et règles de base
lessons.practice: Solve simple event and conditional-probability exercises.

lessons.title: Variables aléatoires et distributions
lessons.practice: Match real situations to common distributions.

lessons.title: Espérance, variance et écart-type
lessons.practice: Compute and interpret expectation and variance on a small example.

lessons.title: Probabilité conditionnelle et Bayes
lessons.practice: Update a probability after receiving new evidence.

lessons.title: Échantillonnage et théorème central limite
lessons.practice: Simulate sample means and observe convergence.

pillars.name: Business Analysis
pillars.intro: Learn how to clarify business problems, understand stakeholders, define needs, and evaluate solutions.

lessons.title: Rôle du Business Analyst et création de valeur
lessons.short: What a Business Analyst actually does
lessons.practice: Turn a vague business request into a problem, need, and desired outcome.

lessons.title: BACCM : Change, Need, Solution, Stakeholder, Value, Context
lessons.practice: Map a simple business case with the six BACCM concepts.

lessons.title: Cartographie des stakeholders
lessons.practice: Map influence, needs, and risks for a small project.

lessons.title: Distinguer problème, besoin et solution
lessons.practice: Rewrite solution-first requests as explicit business needs.

lessons.title: Objectifs, résultats et KPI
lessons.practice: Define one outcome and the KPI that would measure it.

lessons.title: Scope, contexte et contraintes
lessons.practice: Define what is in scope, out of scope, and constrained.

lessons.title: Elicitation : conduire un entretien
lessons.practice: Prepare and run a short stakeholder interview.

pillars.name: AI & Automation
pillars.intro: Learn how modern AI systems work, where automation helps, and how to build reliable workflows.

lessons.title: AI vs ML vs Deep Learning vs Generative AI
lessons.short: AI, ML, deep learning and GenAI
lessons.practice: Classify concrete examples into AI, ML, deep learning, or generative AI.

lessons.title: LLM : tokens, contexte et génération
lessons.practice: Inspect how tokenisation and context change a model response.

lessons.title: Transformers et mécanisme d’attention
lessons.practice: Trace attention through a small conceptual example.

lessons.title: Embeddings et similarité
lessons.practice: Compare text embeddings and interpret similarity scores.

lessons.title: Prompting : instructions, contexte, exemples
lessons.practice: Improve one prompt by adding task, context, constraints, and examples.

lessons.title: Structured outputs
lessons.practice: Define a simple schema and validate model output against it.

lessons.title: Context window et gestion du contexte
lessons.practice: Decide what context to include, compress, or retrieve.

pillars.name: Finance & Risk
pillars.intro: Learn how financial statements, valuation, time, uncertainty, and risk shape financial decisions.

lessons.title: Structure du système financier
lessons.practice: Map the main actors, markets, instruments, and flows in a simple financial system.

lessons.title: Équation comptable et logique débit/crédit
lessons.practice: Record simple transactions and explain their balance-sheet effect.

lessons.title: Income Statement
lessons.practice: Read a simplified P&L and explain revenue, cost, and profit.

lessons.title: Balance Sheet
lessons.practice: Classify assets, liabilities, and equity.

lessons.title: Cash Flow Statement
lessons.practice: Explain the difference between profit and cash generation.

lessons.title: Ratios financiers essentiels
lessons.practice: Calculate and interpret profitability, liquidity, and leverage ratios.

lessons.title: Time Value of Money
lessons.practice: Compare cash flows occurring at different dates.

pillars.name: Marketing & Growth
pillars.intro: Learn how positioning, acquisition, conversion, experimentation, and customer economics drive growth.

lessons.title: Funnel marketing et customer journey
lessons.practice: Map the stages a customer goes through from awareness to conversion.

lessons.title: ICP, persona et segmentation
lessons.practice: Define one ideal customer profile and explain the segment logic.

lessons.title: Positionnement et proposition de valeur
lessons.practice: Write a clear positioning statement for one product.

lessons.title: Canaux d’acquisition
lessons.practice: Compare three channels by fit, cost, speed, and control.

lessons.title: Impressions, reach, clicks, conversions
lessons.practice: Trace impressions to conversions in a simple campaign funnel.

lessons.title: CTR, CVR, CPC et CPA
lessons.practice: Calculate and interpret four acquisition metrics.

lessons.title: Customer Acquisition Cost
lessons.practice: Calculate CAC and discuss what would make it sustainable.

pillars.name: Operations & Strategy
pillars.intro: Learn how processes, capacity, flow, constraints, and strategic choices shape operational performance.

lessons.title: Comprendre un système d’opérations
lessons.practice: Map inputs, process, capacity, output, and constraints for a simple operation.

lessons.title: Process mapping opérationnel
lessons.practice: Draw an end-to-end process and identify handoffs.

lessons.title: Demand vs capacity
lessons.practice: Compare demand with available capacity and identify shortfalls.

lessons.title: Identifier un bottleneck
lessons.practice: Calculate process capacity and identify the limiting step.

lessons.title: Throughput, cycle time et lead time
lessons.practice: Distinguish throughput, cycle time, and lead time in a real process.

lessons.title: Little’s Law
lessons.practice: Use WIP = throughput × flow time on a simple operation.

lessons.title: Utilisation, capacité et productivité
lessons.practice: Compare utilisation, capacity, and productivity for one team.
